passages.text: While Ezra prayed and made this confession, weeping and falling facedown before the house of God, a very large assembly of Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered around him, and the people wept bitterly as well.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a leader and scribe among the Israelites.
Ezra prayed to God.
Ezra confessed the sins of the people.
Ezra wept as he prayed.
Ezra fell facedown before the house of God.
A very large group of Israelites gathered around Ezra.
Men, women, and children came together.
The people also wept bitterly.
passages.original: וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל עֶזְרָא֙ וּכְ֨הִתְוַדֹּת֔וֹ בֹּכֶה֙ וּמִתְנַפֵּ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים נִקְבְּצוּ֩ אֵלָ֨יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קָהָ֣ל רַב־ מְאֹ֗ד אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וִֽילָדִ֔ים כִּֽי־ בָכ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם הַרְבֵּה־ בֶֽכֶה׃ס

passages.text: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, an Elamite, said to Ezra: “We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land, yet in spite of this, there is hope for Israel.
passages.sermon:
Shecaniah was the son of Jehiel.
Shecaniah was from the descendants of Elam.
Shecaniah spoke to Ezra.
Shecaniah said, "We have been unfaithful to our God."
We married foreign women from the people of the land.
But now there is hope for Israel, even after this.
passages.original: וַיַּעַן֩ שְׁכַנְיָ֨ה בֶן־ יְחִיאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵ֤י עוֹלָם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעֶזְרָ֔א אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ מָעַ֣לְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַנֹּ֛שֶׁב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּ֖וֹת מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעַתָּ֛ה יֵשׁ־ מִקְוֶ֥ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־ זֹֽאת׃

passages.text: So now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all the foreign wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the command of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.
passages.sermon:
We are Israelites.
We have married foreign women.
We have children from these marriages.
We have not obeyed God’s command.
Now, let us make a covenant with our God.
We will send away all the foreign wives.
We will send away their children.
We will do this according to the advice of my lord.
We will also follow the counsel of those who fear God’s command.
We will act according to the Law.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה נִֽכְרָת־ בְּרִ֣ית לֵ֠אלֹהֵינוּ לְהוֹצִ֨יא כָל־ נָשִׁ֜ים וְהַנּוֹלָ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ בַּעֲצַ֣ת אֲדֹנָ֔י וְהַחֲרֵדִ֖ים בְּמִצְוַ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָ֖ה יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action!”
passages.sermon:
Ezra, you are responsible for this matter.
We will support you.
Stand up.
Be strong.
Take action.
passages.original: ק֛וּם כִּֽי־ עָלֶ֥יךָ הַדָּבָ֖ר וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ עִמָּ֑ךְ חֲזַ֖ק וַעֲשֵֽׂה׃פ

passages.text: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, Levites, and all Israel take an oath to do what had been said. And they took the oath.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a leader and a scribe among the Israelites.
Ezra stood up.
Ezra called the leading priests.
Ezra called the Levites.
Ezra called all the people of Israel.
Ezra made them take an oath.
The oath was to do what had been commanded.
The leading priests took the oath.
The Levites took the oath.
All Israel took the oath.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֡א וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע אֶת־ שָׂרֵי֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃

passages.text: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and walked to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. And while he stayed there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a leader of the people.
Ezra stood up from before the house of God.
Ezra went to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib.
Ezra stayed in that chamber.
Ezra did not eat any bread there.
Ezra did not drink any water there.
Ezra mourned because the exiles had been unfaithful.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֗א מִלִּפְנֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ אֶל־ לִשְׁכַּ֖ת יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־ אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שָׁ֗ם לֶ֤חֶם לֹֽא־ אָכַל֙ וּמַ֣יִם לֹֽא־ שָׁתָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִתְאַבֵּ֖ל עַל־ מַ֥עַל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃ס

passages.text: And a proclamation was issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the exiles should gather at Jerusalem.
passages.sermon: The leaders sent a message through Judah and Jerusalem.\r\nThey spoke to all the exiles.\r\nThey told the exiles to gather in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֜וֹל בִּיהוּדָ֣ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לְכֹל֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה לְהִקָּבֵ֖ץ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Whoever failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, according to the counsel of the leaders and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.
passages.sermon:
The leaders and elders gave a command to the exiles.
They said every exile must come to Jerusalem within three days.
If anyone did not come within three days, he would lose all his property.
They would take away everything he owned.
He would also be separated from the assembly of the exiles.
He would no longer belong to the group of returned exiles.
passages.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יָב֜וֹא לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים כַּעֲצַ֤ת הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְהַזְּקֵנִ֔ים יָחֳרַ֖ם כָּל־ רְכוּשׁ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִבָּדֵ֖ל מִקְּהַ֥ל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃ס

passages.text: So within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem, and on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people sat in the square at the house of God, trembling regarding this matter and because of the heavy rain.
passages.sermon:
All the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered in Jerusalem.
They assembled within three days.
This happened on the twentieth day of the ninth month.
All the people sat in the square at the house of God.
They trembled because of this matter.
They also trembled because of the heavy rain.
passages.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ כָל־ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ יְהוּדָה֩ וּבִנְיָמִ֨ן׀ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים ה֛וּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ כָל־ הָעָ֗ם בִּרְחוֹב֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מַרְעִידִ֥ים עַל־ הַדָּבָ֖ר וּמֵהַגְּשָׁמִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women, adding to the guilt of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest.
Ezra stood up.
Ezra spoke to the people.
Ezra said, “You have been unfaithful.
You married foreign women.
You increased the guilt of Israel.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֨קָם עֶזְרָ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם מְעַלְתֶּ֔ם וַתֹּשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת לְהוֹסִ֖יף עַל־ אַשְׁמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Now, therefore, make a confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do His will. Separate yourselves from the people of the land and from your foreign wives.”
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a leader of the people of Israel.
He spoke to the people of Judah and Benjamin in Jerusalem.
He said, “Now confess your sins to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of your fathers.
Do what He wants you to do.
Separate yourselves from the people of the land.
Separate yourselves from your foreign wives.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֥וּ תוֹדָ֛ה לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ רְצוֹנ֑וֹ וְהִבָּֽדְלוּ֙ מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמִן־ הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנָּכְרִיּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And the whole assembly responded in a loud voice: “Truly we must do as you say!
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a leader of the people.
Ezra spoke to the people about their sin.
The whole assembly listened to Ezra.
All the people answered together.
They spoke with a loud voice.
They said, “We must do as you say.”
passages.original: וַיַּֽעְנ֧וּ כָֽל־ הַקָּהָ֛ל וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל כֵּ֛ן כְּדִבְרֶיךָ עָלֵ֖ינוּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

passages.text: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.
passages.sermon:
Many people are gathered here.
It is the rainy season now.
We do not have the strength to stand outside.
This task will take more than one or two days.
We have sinned greatly in this matter.
passages.original: אֲבָ֞ל הָעָ֥ם רָב֙ וְהָעֵ֣ת גְּשָׁמִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמ֣וֹד בַּח֑וּץ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה לֹֽא־ לְי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ וְלֹ֣א לִשְׁנַ֔יִם כִּֽי־ הִרְבִּ֥ינוּ לִפְשֹׁ֖עַ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Let our leaders represent the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at an appointed time, together with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us.”
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel had sinned by marrying foreign women.
Our leaders must stand and represent the whole assembly.
Every man in our towns who has married a foreign woman must come at a set time.
The elders and judges of each town must come with them.
We must do this until God’s fierce anger in this matter turns away from us.
passages.original: יַֽעֲמְדוּ־ נָ֣א שָׂ֠רֵינוּ לְֽכָל־ הַקָּהָ֞ל וְכֹ֣ל׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֶּעָרֵ֗ינוּ הַהֹשִׁ֞יב נָשִׁ֤ים נָכְרִיּוֹת֙ יָבֹא֙ לְעִתִּ֣ים מְזֻמָּנִ֔ים וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם זִקְנֵי־ עִ֥יר וָעִ֖יר וְשֹׁפְטֶ֑יהָ עַ֠ד לְהָשִׁ֞יב חֲר֤וֹן אַף־ אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עַ֖ד לַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃פ

passages.text: (Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite, opposed this plan.)
passages.sermon:
Jonathan was the son of Asahel.
Jahzeiah was the son of Tikvah.
Jonathan and Jahzeiah opposed this plan.
Meshullam supported them.
Shabbethai was a Levite.
Shabbethai also supported them.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֧ן בֶּן־ עֲשָׂהאֵ֛ל וְיַחְזְיָ֥ה בֶן־ תִּקְוָ֖ה עָמְד֣וּ עַל־ זֹ֑את וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם וְשַׁבְּתַ֥י הַלֵּוִ֖י עֲזָרֻֽם׃

passages.text: So the exiles did as proposed. Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads, each of them identified by name, to represent their families. On the first day of the tenth month they launched the investigation, and by the first day of the first month they had dealt with all the men who had married foreign women.
passages.sermon:
The exiles obeyed the plan.
Ezra was a priest.
Ezra chose men to help.
These men were heads of families.
Each man was named.
They represented their families.
They began their work on the first day of the tenth month.
They started to investigate the matter.
They finished by the first day of the first month.
They dealt with all the men who had married foreign women.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵן֮ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָה֒ וַיִּבָּדְלוּ֩ עֶזְרָ֨א הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲנָשִׁ֨ים רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם וְכֻלָּ֣ם בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת וַיֵּשְׁב֗וּ בְּי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י לְדַרְי֖וֹשׁ הַדָּבָֽר׃ וַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַכֹּ֔ל אֲנָשִׁ֕ים הַהֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת עַ֛ד י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃פ

passages.text: Among the descendants of the priests who had married foreign women were found these descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
passages.sermon:
Some priests had married foreign women.
Jeshua was the son of Jozadak.
Jeshua had brothers.
Among Jeshua’s descendants and his brothers were Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
These men were found among the priests who had married foreign women.
passages.original: וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת מִבְּנֵ֨י יֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־ יֽוֹצָדָק֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֔זֶר וְיָרִ֖יב וּגְדַלְיָֽה׃

passages.text: They pledged to send their wives away, and for their guilt they presented a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.
passages.sermon:
The men made a promise.
They promised to send away their wives.
These wives were foreign women.
The men felt guilty for what they had done.
They brought a ram from the flock.
They gave the ram as a guilt offering.
passages.original: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ יָדָ֖ם לְהוֹצִ֣יא נְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֵׁמִ֥ים אֵֽיל־ צֹ֖אן עַל־ אַשְׁמָתָֽם׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
passages.sermon: Immer was a priestly family.\r\nHanani was a descendant of Immer.\r\nZebadiah was a descendant of Immer.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר חֲנָ֖נִי וּזְבַדְיָֽה׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
passages.sermon: Harim was an ancestor in Israel.\r\nSome men descended from Harim.\r\nTheir names were Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂיָ֤ה וְאֵֽלִיָּה֙ וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וִיחִיאֵ֖ל וְעֻזִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: From the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Pashhur are a specific family group in Israel.
Elioenai is one descendant of Pashhur.
Maaseiah is another descendant of Pashhur.
Ishmael is also a descendant of Pashhur.
Nethanel is a descendant of Pashhur.
Jozabad is a descendant of Pashhur.
Elasah is a descendant of Pashhur.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י פַּשְׁח֑וּר אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל נְתַנְאֵ֔ל יוֹזָבָ֖ד וְאֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃ס

passages.text: Among the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served God in the temple.
\r\nSome Levites were named in this list.
\r\nJozabad was a Levite.
\r\nShimei was a Levite.
\r\nKelaiah was a Levite.
\r\nKelaiah was also called Kelita.
\r\nPethahiah was a Levite.
\r\nJudah was a Levite.
\r\nEliezer was a Levite.
passages.original: וּמִֽן־ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם יוֹזָבָ֣ד וְשִׁמְעִ֗י וְקֵֽלָיָה֙ ה֣וּא קְלִיטָ֔א פְּתַֽחְיָ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃ס

passages.text: From the singers: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
passages.sermon:
The singers served in the temple.
Eliashib was a singer.
The gatekeepers guarded the entrances.
Shallum was a gatekeeper.
Telem was a gatekeeper.
Uri was a gatekeeper.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וּמִן־ הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים שַׁלֻּ֥ם וָטֶ֖לֶם וְאוּרִֽי׃ס

passages.text: And among the other Israelites, from the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.
passages.sermon: These men are Israelites.\r\nThey come from the descendants of Parosh.\r\nTheir names are Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.
passages.original: וּמִֽיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִבְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֡שׁ רַ֠מְיָה וְיִזִּיָּ֤ה וּמַלְכִּיָּה֙ וּמִיָּמִ֣ן וְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וּמַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וּבְנָיָֽה׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
passages.sermon: These men are descendants of Elam.\r\nTheir names are Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י עֵילָ֑ם מַתַּנְיָ֤ה זְכַרְיָה֙ וִיחִיאֵ֣ל וְעַבְדִּ֔י וִירֵמ֖וֹת וְאֵלִיָּֽה׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
passages.sermon: The following men are descendants of Zattu.\r\nTheir names are Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י זַתּ֑וּא אֶלְיוֹעֵנַ֤י אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה וִֽירֵמ֔וֹת וְזָבָ֖ד וַעֲזִיזָֽא׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
passages.sermon: The descendants of Bebai include four men.\r\nTheir names are Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י בֵּבָ֑י יְהוֹחָנָ֥ן חֲנַנְיָ֖ה זַבַּ֥י עַתְלָֽי׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Bani are a family group in Israel.
Meshullam is one of the descendants of Bani.
Malluch is also a descendant of Bani.
Adaiah belongs to the family of Bani.
Jashub is from the descendants of Bani.
Sheal is a member of Bani’s descendants.
Jeremoth is also one of the descendants of Bani.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י בָּנִ֑י מְשֻׁלָּ֤ם מַלּוּךְ֙ וַעֲדָיָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב וּשְׁאָ֥ל יְרֵמוֹת׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Pahath-moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
passages.sermon: The descendants of Pahath-moab are a group of Israelites.\r\nTheir names are Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֛י פַּחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב עַדְנָ֣א וּכְלָ֑ל בְּנָיָ֤ה מַעֲשֵׂיָה֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה בְצַלְאֵ֔ל וּבִנּ֖וּי וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Harim include several men.
Eliezer is one descendant of Harim.
Isshijah is another descendant of Harim.
Malchijah is also a descendant of Harim.
Shemaiah is a descendant of Harim.
Shimeon is a descendant of Harim.
Benjamin is a descendant of Harim.
Malluch is a descendant of Harim.
Shemariah is a descendant of Harim.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם אֱלִיעֶ֧זֶר יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה מַלְכִּיָּ֖ה שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃ בְּנְיָמִ֥ן מַלּ֖וּךְ שְׁמַרְיָֽה׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
passages.sermon: The following men are descendants of Hashum.\r\nTheir names are Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
passages.original: מִבְּנֵ֖י חָשֻׁ֑ם מַתְּנַ֤י מַתַּתָּה֙ זָבָ֣ד אֱלִיפֶ֔לֶט יְרֵמַ֥י מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה שִׁמְעִֽי׃ס

passages.text: From the descendants of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi, Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu.
passages.sermon:
The following men are descendants of Bani.
Their names are Maadai, Amram, and Uel.
Benaiah, Bedeiah, and Cheluhi are also descendants of Bani.
Vaniah, Meremoth, and Eliashib belong to this group.
Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu are included among the descendants of Bani.
passages.original: מִבְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔י מַעֲדַ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם וְאוּאֵֽל׃ס בְּנָיָ֥ה בֵדְיָ֖ה כְּלָהַי׃ וַנְיָ֥ה מְרֵמ֖וֹת אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃ מַתַּנְיָ֥ה מַתְּנַ֖י וְיַעֲשׂוֹ׃

passages.text: From the descendants of Binnui: Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
passages.sermon:
The following men are descendants of Binnui.
Shimei is a descendant of Binnui.
Shelemiah is a descendant of Binnui.
Nathan is a descendant of Binnui.
Adaiah is a descendant of Binnui.
Machnadebai is a descendant of Binnui.
Shashai is a descendant of Binnui.
Sharai is a descendant of Binnui.
Azarel is a descendant of Binnui.
Shelemiah is a descendant of Binnui.
Shemariah is a descendant of Binnui.
Shallum is a descendant of Binnui.
Amariah is a descendant of Binnui.
Joseph is a descendant of Binnui.
passages.original: וּבָנִ֥י וּבִנּ֖וּי שִׁמְעִֽי׃ וְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥ה וְנָתָ֖ן וַעֲדָיָֽה׃ מַכְנַדְבַ֥י שָׁשַׁ֖י שָׁרָֽי׃ עֲזַרְאֵ֥ל וְשֶׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ שְׁמַרְיָֽה׃ שַׁלּ֥וּם אֲמַרְיָ֖ה יוֹסֵֽף׃ס

passages.text: And from the descendants of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.
passages.sermon: The descendants of Nebo were a group of men.\r\nTheir names were Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.
passages.original: מִבְּנֵ֖י נְב֑וֹ יְעִיאֵ֤ל מַתִּתְיָה֙ זָבָ֣ד זְבִינָ֔א יַדּוֹ וְיוֹאֵ֖ל בְּנָיָֽה׃

passages.text: All these men had married foreign women, and some of them had children by these wives.
passages.sermon: These men married foreign women.\r\nSome of these men had children with these wives.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֵ֕לֶּה נָשְׂא֖י נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת וְיֵ֣שׁ מֵהֶ֣ם נָשִׁ֔ים וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בָּנִֽים׃פ
